reading: People across the country are being asked to give their opinions on proposals for a new government-owned renewable energy company in Wales.
This proposed company's primary purpose would be to build and own wind and solar power plants.
Its long-term plans aim to reduce energy costs for people.
However, the new company would not directly set household electricity charges or replace existing suppliers.
It also intends to support communities in taking a part-ownership in these energy projects.
The Welsh government currently has an onshore wind and solar project creator called Trydan Gwyrdd Cymru (TGC).
Ministers are suggesting combining TGC with other current Welsh energy initiatives to create a stronger new enterprise.
Enterprise Minister Adam Price expressed a desire for a Welsh energy system that is 'clean, cheap and owned by us'.
The company would also seek to attract investment into Welsh energy infrastructure.
Additionally, a Welsh Energy Wealth Fund is being considered to support vulnerable people in Wales.

vocabulary.definition: Suggested or put forward for consideration.
The main reason or goal for which something exists.
Continuing for, or concerned with, a long period in the future.
Relating to a house and its occupants.
Has a plan or purpose in mind.
The state of owning only a portion or share of something.
Happening or existing at the present time.
A business or a project, especially one that is difficult or important.

entries.ja: 検討のために提案された、または提示されたもの。
entries.es: Sugerido o presentado para su consideración.

entries.ja: 何かが存在する主な理由や目的。
entries.ko: 어떤 것이 존재하는 주된 이유나 목표.
entries.zh-Hans: 某事物存在的主要原因或目标。
entries.es: La razón o el objetivo principal por el cual algo existe.
entries.pt-BR: A principal razão ou objetivo para o qual algo existe.

entries.ja: 将来の長い期間にわたって続く、またはそれに関係する。
entries.ko: 미래의 긴 기간 동안 계속되거나 그와 관련된.
entries.zh-Hans: 持续或关注未来的一个很长时期。
entries.es: Que continúa durante un largo período en el futuro, o que se ocupa de él.
entries.pt-BR: Que continua por um longo período no futuro, ou que se refere a ele.

entries.ja: 家とその居住者に関する。
entries.zh-Hans: 与房屋及其居住者相关的。
entries.es: Relativo a una casa y a sus ocupantes.
entries.pt-BR: Relativo a uma casa e aos seus ocupantes.

entries.ja: 計画や目的を心に持っている。
entries.es: Tener un plan o propósito en mente.
entries.pt-BR: Ter um plano ou propósito em mente.

entries.ja: 何かの一部または株式のみを所有している状態。
entries.ko: 어떤 것의 일부 또는 지분만을 소유하고 있는 상태.
entries.zh-Hans: 仅拥有某物的一部分或份额的状态。
entries.es: El estado de poseer solo una porción o una parte de algo.
entries.pt-BR: O estado de possuir apenas uma porção ou parte de algo.

entries.ja: 現在起こっている、または存在している。
entries.zh-Hans: 在当前时间正在发生或存在的。
entries.es: Que está sucediendo o existe en el momento presente.
entries.pt-BR: Acontecendo ou existindo no momento presente.

entries.ja: ビジネスまたはプロジェクト、特に困難または重要なもの。
entries.ko: 사업이나 프로젝트, 특히 어렵거나 중요한 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 一项业务或一个项目，尤其指那些困难或重要的。
entries.es: Un negocio o un proyecto, especialmente uno que es difícil o importante.
entries.pt-BR: Um negócio ou um projeto, especialmente um que é difícil ou importante.
